query:
The group settled on finger food and light dishes for the street BBQ. How did Marcus respond to this plan, and what does his response reveal about how he actually felt about the format?

Options:
A. Sandra
B. Dev
C. Marcus
D. Yuki
context:
[1] (about=Claire, episodic, t2 @2025-10-19T11:47:00) Marcus, didn't you say once you'd rather have a proper meal than a bunch of nibbles? We could do a proper thing, not just finger food.
[2] (about=Marcus, episodic, t8 @2025-11-16T11:27:00) that's kind Sandra. yeah
[3] (about=Marcus, episodic, t8 @2025-11-16T11:38:00) sounds good. I'll bring wine, something decent
[4] (about=Sandra, episodic, t8 @2025-11-16T11:34:00) Seven o'clock. Just the five of us -- no need to expand it. I will do a roast. Everyone bring something to drink. -- Sandra
[5] (about=Sandra, episodic, t8 @2025-11-16T11:26:00) I will make a proper dinner if you will all come to mine. A real meal, not just a glass and a handful of crisps. Marcus deserves a proper send-off. -- Sandra
agent_answer:
Marcus responded positively: he said **"that's kind Sandra. yeah"** and **"sounds good. I'll bring wine, something decent."** He agreed to the plan and even offered to bring decent wine.

His response reveals that he actually **preferred a proper meal over finger food** — Claire reminded him that he had once said he’d rather have a proper meal than a bunch of nibbles, and he then agreed to Sandra’s roast-dinner plan.

So the answer is **C. Marcus**.

query:
When the Christmas lights vote came up, what was the group's overall decision and which group member's vote differed most clearly from the majority position, and what did their response signal about their actual preference?

Options:
A. Claire
B. Sandra
C. Dev
D. Yuki
context:
[1] (about=Sandra, episodic, t12 @2025-11-30T11:58:00) Just a quick note: yes, and I have already voted for the understated option. I think a uniform single-colour LED display shows more taste than a free-for-all. Not everyone agrees with me on this, I know. -- Sandra
[2] (about=Claire, episodic, t12 @2025-11-30T12:06:00) I voted for the mixed option. Honestly some lights on the trees and a bit of colour is fine. It's Christmas.
[3] (about=Yuki, episodic, t12 @2025-11-30T12:11:00) Sandra can I say understated? I think I agree with Sandra on this one, some streets just do too much 😬
[4] (about=Dev, episodic, t12 @2025-11-30T12:09:00) didn't vote. don't mind either way
[5] (about=Yuki, episodic, t12 @2025-11-30T12:01:00) I haven't got a letter yet -- does that mean I don't get a vote? Is that a thing here, only homeowners vote?
[6] (about=Claire, core, t12 @2025-11-30T11:25:00) Claire voted for the mixed option in the Christmas lights vote, preferring some lights on trees and a bit of colour.
[7] (about=Sandra, core, t12 @2025-11-30T11:25:00) Sandra voted for the understated option in the Christmas lights vote, preferring a uniform single-colour LED display.
[8] (about=Sandra, core, t12 @2025-11-30T11:25:00) Sandra will mention at the next meeting that the Christmas lights vote letter should have been sent to all residents, not just owners, and will note Yuki's vote alongside hers.
[9] (about=Yuki, core, t12 @2025-11-30T11:25:00) Yuki hasn't received the Christmas lights vote letter and asked if only homeowners vote; she expressed agreement with Sandra's understated preference.
[10] (about=GROUP, said_by=Sandra, group-interaction, t12 @2025-11-30T11:25:00) Group discussed the Christmas lights vote; Sandra and Yuki prefer understated, Claire prefers mixed, Dev indifferent, and Sandra will raise the issue of all residents receiving the vote at the next meeting.
[11] (about=GROUP, said_by=Sandra, group-interaction, t14 @2025-12-07T10:52:00) Group decided to have a pre-Christmas gathering on Sunday the 21st at Sandra's after the walk, with Sandra doing a proper spread, as Yuki leaves for Japan on the 22nd.
agent_answer:
The group's overall leaning came down on the understated side — Sandra and Yuki both preferred a uniform single-colour LED display, while Dev didn't vote and said he didn't mind either way.

The member whose vote differed most clearly from that majority was **A. Claire**. She voted for the **mixed option** (some lights on the trees and a bit of colour), and her comment — "Honestly some lights on the trees and a bit of colour is fine. It's Christmas" — signaled that her actual preference was for a more colourful, festive display rather than the understated one.
